title: Megurine Luka — Photo Contest in SEKAI!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm done polishing the cups and saucers, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you for doing that, Miku.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but would you mind also putting them back up on the shelf for me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Actually, I was just about to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Will you two please stop ignoring me already...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but we're busy here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So am I!
You have no idea what it's like being this bored!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: At this rate, I'm going to end up an unhappy husk of what I used to be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You poor thing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since you're so bored, why don't I get you a drink and a snack?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yay♪ Oh, but...
I'll be bored again after I'm done.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
If only Kohane and the others were here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's nothing we can do about that since they're probably performing in an event somewhere right now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, they come by fairly often to take breaks and practice on their own.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but I want to have more fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: More fun...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
If only we could do something again like we did during Valentine's Day...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, that's it...!
We can have one ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Miku & MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, I'm happy to announce that we'll be having a photo contest to see who wins the Crase Cafe Cup♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Crase Cafe Cup? Does that mean you're hosting this, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, she just wanted it in the title because it sounded “cool”...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A photo contest? Like the one Kohane and Toya entered? That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, what are we supposed to do?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, I'll start by explaining the rules!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'll split into two teams of three, and each team will designate someone to be their model. After that, they'll put on makeup and have their pictures taken!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And the theme of this contest is Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Aren't those the same rules as the photo contest Kohane and the others entered?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, because it makes things easier♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, you just didn't want to come up with new rules.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also true.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, that's the only truth...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's start picking teams.
My little ladder diagram here will randomly assign us to teams, so write your names down for me. Also, the fastest team gets to claim the best spots to shoot!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It still feels like you're doing this all on the fly.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, here are our teams.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We have Rin, Miku and myself in one!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: With Len, MEIKO and KAITO in the other!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just as a reminder, each team needs to choose a model and do their makeup so that it has a Valentine's Day feel to it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do we have any makeup to use?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Heehee. We're all set. Kohane let me borrow the makeup she used for the photo contest.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I also asked her and the others to be our judges.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, you're more prepared than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By the way, also...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The winner gets chocolate parfaits brimming with the chocolates we have left over from Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & KAITO
rows.Line: Chocolate parfaits?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You always make sure to have only these sorts of things covered...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, everyone, let's all put our best foot forward and see who takes the best picture!

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah!
